When you see the world has collapsed or when you see the world in chaos, you have children because children give you the energy, motivation, and inspiration to fight for a better world. I am probably the most pessimistic person on planet Earth. I think the entire world is going to hell. I have three kids, three young kids. First of all, I love my kids and having children fills me with hope, energy, and power to fight for a better world. I'm only doing this; I'm only teaching this class and putting it on YouTube to build a legacy for my children.

If it were not for my children, I would honestly not be doing this. It's really hard work. Thank you guys. We'll continue next week.
